RECOMMENDATION: DON'T RAISE IT
LIKELIHOOD: Cannot responsibly assign a number from these facts

An all-women panel is not, by itself, evidence of sex bias. Your PhD and eight years of section leadership are substantial qualifications, but a laboratory-head role may prioritize broader management experience over academic credentials.

Follow up now on your written request. Ask for the selection criteria, their weighting, feedback on your assessment, and how the successful candidate met the requirements.

Raise concerns about sex discrimination if concrete evidence emerges—for example, sex-related comments, inconsistent standards, or departures from the advertised criteria—not merely the panel’s composition. Check local complaint deadlines; waiting for an explanation may not pause them.
